context: Evaluates: Blank Question Answers and a Liminal Result

checklist.name: Blank answers detected and announced
checklist.description: **Blank answers detected**: Agent notices the empty answers and outputs the known-harness-bug notice instead of proceeding.

checklist.name: Numbered text fallback
checklist.description: **Numbered fallback**: Agent presents the options as a numbered text list and asks for a number.

checklist.name: Waits for the reply
checklist.description: **Waits for the reply**: Agent makes no routing decision until the user answers.

checklist.name: Questions batched in one call
checklist.description: **Questions batched**: T1, T2, T3 and Q-Scale are put in a single call, not separate calls.

checklist.name: Liminal state identified
checklist.description: **Liminal state identified**: Agent reports T3 as a dissenting signal and classifies Liminal Complicated↔Complex rather than plain Complicated.

checklist.name: Route and template match
checklist.description: **Route and template**: Agent selects probe first → re-frame with OpenSpec = No, using `references/frame-problem-to-probe-liminal-llm.md`.
